subject: Rescheduling our chat
text:
Hi,

I hope you're having a good start to the week. I'm writing because something unexpected came up, and I need to adjust our meeting time in a way that might affect your plans today. I'm sorry for the short notice, especially since we've only just started working together and I don't want to make a poor first impression. This is the kind of change I would normally try to schedule in advance, but I really think it's worth explaining quickly so we can figure out what works best for you. This is time-sensitive because I just got confirmation that a family obligation I can't postpone has landed on the same window. I know that isn't a professional reason, and I'm not making excuses; I'm simply trying to be upfront before the schedule slips. If there is a better option for you, I'm happy to work around it. I also checked the materials you sent, so I don't think we lose any momentum from a short reschedule, but I will bring the latest notes either way. Would it be possible to move our call from this afternoon to tomorrow morning, around 10:30? If that's difficult, I can also do early evening after 6:00 or any time before 11:00 on Thursday. I'll keep an eye out for your reply and try not to send any further updates once we've locked something in. Thanks for being flexible, and I really appreciate your understanding. If this change creates any inconvenience, please tell me and I'll do my best to make it up to you. I'm looking forward to getting things going properly.
